name: io.github.GetActionSpace/mcp-context-server
description: MCP server providing persistent multimodal context storage for LLM agents.

environmentVariables.description: Log level
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Storage backend type: sqlite (default) or postgresql
environmentVariables.name: STORAGE_BACKEND

environmentVariables.description: Maximum individual image size in megabytes

environmentVariables.name: MAX_TOTAL_SIZE_MB

environmentVariables.name: POOL_MAX_READERS

environmentVariables.name: POOL_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: SQLite busy timeout in milliseconds

environmentVariables.description: SQLite WAL checkpoint mode: PASSIVE, FULL, RESTART or TRUNCATE (case-insensitive); any other value is rejected at startup

environmentVariables.name: SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_HOST

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_PORT

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_USER

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL role that owns the tables. Schema setup and migrations connect with the request connection settings (POSTGRESQL_CONNECTION_STRING or the component fields) and this user in place of the request user; unset keeps the request user. Required when ENABLE_POSTGRESQL_RLS=true
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_MIGRATION_USER

environmentVariables.description: Password for POSTGRESQL_MIGRATION_USER, used in place of the request password on the schema setup and migration connection; unset keeps the request password
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL database name
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_DATABASE

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection pool minimum size
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_POOL_MIN

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection pool maximum size
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_POOL_MAX

environmentVariables.description: Per-session client cap of an external session-mode pooler (Supabase Session Pooler / Supavisor); advisory threshold for a startup MaxClientsInSessionMode warning when POSTGRESQL_POOL_MAX exceeds it (default 15)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_SESSION_POOLER_MAX_CLIENTS

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection-pool acquire-wait timeout in seconds (default: 120.0, must be > 0). This is the maximum time a request waits to acquire a connection from the pool (passed per-call to pool.acquire), not the query execution timeout and not the connection establishment timeout (see POSTGRESQL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S). For embedding-load robustness, tune POSTGRESQL_POOL_MAX and POSTGRESQL_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S.
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_POOL_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection ESTABLISHMENT timeout in seconds (default: 60.0, the asyncpg default; must be > 0): TCP connect plus startup handshake for each new connection the pool or the pgvector pre-check opens. Distinct from POSTGRESQL_POOL_TIMEOUT_S, which bounds waiting for a free pooled connection, and must be strictly below it: asyncpg bounds the dial by the acquire deadline, so an equal or larger connect budget can never elapse and the pair is refused at startup.
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL command execution timeout in seconds (must be > 0)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for PostgreSQL migration operations (default: 300)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_MIGRATION_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Close idle PostgreSQL connections after this many seconds (0 to disable, default: 300)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_MAX_INACTIVE_LIFETIME_S

environmentVariables.description: Recycle PostgreSQL connections after this many queries (0 to disable, default: 10000)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_MAX_QUERIES

environmentVariables.description: Seconds of idle time before sending first TCP keepalive probe (0 to disable, default: 15)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_TCP_KEEPALIVES_IDLE_S

environmentVariables.description: Seconds between subsequent TCP keepalive probes (0 to disable, default: 5)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_TCP_KEEPALIVES_INTERVAL_S

environmentVariables.description: Number of failed TCP keepalive probes before connection is considered dead (0 to disable, default: 3)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_TCP_KEEPALIVES_COUNT

environmentVariables.description: asyncpg prepared statement cache size. Set to 0 for external pooler compatibility (PgBouncer transaction mode, Pgpool-II, etc.). Default: 100
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_STATEMENT_CACHE_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Maximum lifetime of cached prepared statements in seconds (default: 300). Has no effect when statement_cache_size=0
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_MAX_CACHED_STATEMENT_LIFETIME_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of statement to cache in bytes (default: 15360). Has no effect when statement_cache_size=0
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_MAX_CACHEABLE_STATEMENT_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL SSL mode (disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca, verify-full)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_SSL_MODE

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL schema name for table and index operations (default: public)
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_SCHEMA

environmentVariables.description: Semantic search tool registration. Tri-state: auto (default), true, or false. auto registers the semantic_search_context tool when an embedding provider is available (and stays silent otherwise); true registers it when a provider is available, otherwise logs a warning and skips registration (it does not force the tool on without a provider); false skips registration. Embedding storage is provisioned by ENABLE_EMBEDDING_GENERATION, independently of this toggle.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_SEMANTIC_SEARCH

environmentVariables.description: Enable embedding generation for stored context. Default true - server fails if dependencies not met. Set false to disable embeddings.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_EMBEDDING_GENERATION

environmentVariables.description: Ollama API host URL for embedding generation
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Automatically pull missing Ollama models on startup (default: true)
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL

environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for pulling Ollama models (default: 900, range: 30-3600)
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_PULL_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Ollama embedding truncation mode: false (default) returns error when context exceeded, true enables silent truncation
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_OLLAMA_TRUNCATE

environmentVariables.description: Ollama embedding context window size in tokens (default: 4096, range: 512-2097152)
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_OLLAMA_NUM_CTX

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name for semantic search
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Embedding vector dimensions
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_DIM

environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for embedding generation API calls
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for embedding generation
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS

environmentVariables.description: Base delay in seconds between retry attempts (with exponential backoff)
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent embedding generation operations (default: 3, range: 1-20)
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MAX_CONCURRENT

environmentVariables.description: Instruction prefix prepended verbatim to the text embedded for search queries (semantic and hybrid search); document embeddings on the store/update path always stay bare. Unset or empty leaves query text unchanged. Recommended for instruct-aware models such as the default qwen3-embedding:0.6b; cloud models such as OpenAI text-embedding-3-small need no prefix.
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_QUERY_INSTRUCTION

environmentVariables.description: Enable summary generation for stored context. Default true - server fails if dependencies not met. Set false to disable summaries.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_SUMMARY_GENERATION

environmentVariables.description: Summary provider: ollama (default), openai, or anthropic
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Summary generation model name (default: qwen3:0.6b)
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Maximum output tokens for summary generation (default: 4000, range: 50-16384). Increase if summaries are truncated by reasoning models
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for summary generation API calls
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for summary generation
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS

environmentVariables.description: Base delay in seconds between retry attempts (with exponential backoff)
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent summary generation operations (default: 2, range: 1-20)
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_MAX_CONCURRENT

environmentVariables.description: Custom summarization prompt. Overrides the built-in default. Used as system message for the LLM.
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_PROMPT

environmentVariables.description: Minimum text content length in characters to trigger summary generation (default: 500, range: 0-10000). Set to 0 to always generate.
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_MIN_CONTENT_LENGTH

environmentVariables.description: Ollama summary context window size in tokens (default: 32768, range: 512-2097152)
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_OLLAMA_NUM_CTX

environmentVariables.description: Ollama summary truncation mode: false (default) returns error when context exceeded, true enables silent truncation
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_OLLAMA_TRUNCATE

environmentVariables.description: Presence penalty sent with every Ollama summary call (0-2). Unset: a qwen3 model gets 1.5, the value its model card prescribes against endless repetition with reasoning off; any other model gets no penalty. An explicit value applies to whatever model is configured; 0 disables it
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_OLLAMA_PRESENCE_PENALTY

environmentVariables.description: Reasoning effort level for OpenAI reasoning models (default: low). Valid values vary by generation: gpt-5: low, medium, high; gpt-5.1+: none, low, medium, high, xhigh. Default low is universally valid across all generations
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT

environmentVariables.description: Effort level for Anthropic Claude models (default: not sent / omitted). Valid values: max, high, medium, low. Controls inference effort (adaptive thinking)
environmentVariables.name: SUMMARY_ANTHROPIC_EFFORT

environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key for summary generation
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Full-text search tool registration. Tri-state: auto (default), true, or false. auto registers full-text search by default (FTS needs no extra dependencies); true forces registration; false skips it.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_FTS

environmentVariables.description: Language for FTS stemming (e.g., english, german, french)
environmentVariables.name: FTS_LANGUAGE

environmentVariables.description: Characters of context around each FTS match for reranking passage extraction (default: 750)
environmentVariables.name: FTS_RERANK_WINDOW_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Merge FTS match regions within this character distance (default: 100)
environmentVariables.name: FTS_RERANK_GAP_MERGE

environmentVariables.description: Hybrid search tool registration (combines FTS and semantic search with RRF fusion). Tri-state: auto (default), true, or false. auto and true both register hybrid search when at least one of FTS or semantic search is available (otherwise a warning is logged and it is skipped, since hybrid has no underlying mode to fuse and true cannot force it on with neither); false skips it.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_HYBRID_SEARCH

environmentVariables.description: grep_context tool registration (server-side literal/regex line-oriented search). Tri-state: auto (default; pure-Python matching, no extra dependencies), true, or false.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_GREP_CONTEXT

environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling applied to grep_context max_matches per request (default 1000).
environmentVariables.name: GREP_MAX_MATCHES_CAP

environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling applied to grep_context context_lines per request (default 20).
environmentVariables.name: GREP_MAX_CONTEXT_LINES

environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling on the number of entries the grep scan visits (default 1000).
environmentVariables.name: GREP_MAX_ENTRIES_SCANNED

environmentVariables.description: Approximate resident-memory cap (summed code-point length of fetched text) before a grep scan stops; the first entry that crosses the budget is still scanned (default 67108864).
environmentVariables.name: GREP_AGGREGATE_BYTES_BUDGET

environmentVariables.description: Per-entry timeout in seconds for is_regex=true matching (ReDoS guard; a timeout skips that entry, never aborts the read; default 5.0).
environmentVariables.name: GREP_REGEX_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Aggregate wall-clock budget in seconds across an entire is_regex=true scan (GREP_REGEX_TIMEOUT_S bounds one entry; this bounds the cumulative scan). When exceeded the scan stops and returns partial results with truncated=true, never aborting the read; default 30.0.
environmentVariables.name: GREP_REGEX_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum grep_context pattern length in characters, advertised in the wire schema and re-checked in the tool body (compilation runs before any matching timeout, so an unbounded pattern could stall a request just to compile; default 32768).
environmentVariables.name: GREP_MAX_PATTERN_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: read_context_range tool registration (partial read by character or line range). Tri-state: auto (default; no extra dependencies), true, or false.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_CONTEXT_RANGE

environmentVariables.description: plan_context_sync and list_ingest_state tool registration (corpus sync planning and stored ingest state). Tri-state: auto (default; no extra dependencies), true, or false.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_CONTEXT_SYNC

environmentVariables.description: navigate_context tool registration (code-derived Markdown outline / index_tree). Tri-state: auto (default; pure-Python, no extra dependencies), true, or false.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_CONTEXT_NAVIGATION

environmentVariables.description: Generate per-node LLM summaries for the navigate_context index_tree and provision the context_index_nodes table. Additive/never-raise: a node-summary failure never aborts a store. Default true.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_INDEX_TREE_NODE_SUMMARIES

environmentVariables.description: Override the per-node index_tree summary system prompt. Empty resolves to a dedicated short headline-style abstract prompt.
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_TREE_NODE_SUMMARY_PROMPT

environmentVariables.description: Heading sections shorter than this (characters) skip per-node summary generation (0 = always). Default 500.
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_TREE_NODE_SUMMARY_MIN_CONTENT_LENGTH

environmentVariables.description: Per-node summary timeout in seconds; a timeout omits that node, never aborts the store. Default 240.
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_TREE_NODE_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Output token budget of one per-node index_tree summary call (num_predict for Ollama, max_tokens for OpenAI and Anthropic). Default 120, sized for a 25-word headline; an answer cut off at this budget drops that node's summary, so a model that loops on one section never spends SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_TREE_NODE_SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Node-task fan-out cap for per-node index_tree summary coroutines; NOT a second model budget (summary-model concurrency is governed by SUMMARY_MAX_CONCURRENT). Default min(cpu_count, 4).
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_TREE_NODE_SUMMARY_MAX_CONCURRENT

environmentVariables.description: Maximum heading sections summarized per entry; bounds TOTAL per-node summary work (the shallowest and longest sections are summarized first). Default 200.
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_TREE_NODE_SUMMARY_MAX_NODES

environmentVariables.description: Aggregate wall-clock budget in seconds for the whole per-node summary pass of one entry; on expiry the pass keeps what it produced and never aborts the store. Default 600.
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_TREE_NODE_SUMMARY_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: RRF smoothing constant for hybrid search (default 60)
environmentVariables.name: HYBRID_RRF_K

environmentVariables.description: Multiplier for over-fetching results before RRF fusion (default: 2)
environmentVariables.name: HYBRID_RRF_OVERFETCH

environmentVariables.description: Minimum significant query terms to switch hybrid FTS from AND to OR logic (default: 4)
environmentVariables.name: HYBRID_FTS_OR_THRESHOLD

environmentVariables.description: Maximum character length for truncated text_content in search results (default: 300, range: 50-1000)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_TRUNCATION_LENGTH

environmentVariables.description: Whether get_context_by_ids includes the summary field in each returned entry. Tri-state: when false (default), the summary key is omitted entirely (consumers reading entry.get('summary') receive None -- the conventional Python signal for 'feature disabled'); when true with a stored non-empty summary, the value is returned verbatim; when true but the stored summary is NULL or empty, the value is normalized to an empty string '' (signaling 'feature on, no data yet'). The text_content field always contains the full untruncated text regardless of this toggle. Does not affect search tools, which always emit summary as a string.
environmentVariables.name: GET_CONTEXT_BY_IDS_INCLUDE_SUMMARY

environmentVariables.description: Enable text chunking for embedding generation (default: true)
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_CHUNKING

environmentVariables.description: Target chunk size in characters (default: 1500)
environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Overlap between chunks in characters (default: 150)
environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_OVERLAP

environmentVariables.description: Chunk score aggregation method: max (only 'max' supported in current version)
environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_AGGREGATION

environmentVariables.description: Reranking provider (default: flashrank)
environmentVariables.name: RERANKING_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Reranking model name (default: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2)
environmentVariables.name: RERANKING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Maximum input length for reranking in tokens (default: 512)
environmentVariables.name: RERANKING_MAX_LENGTH

environmentVariables.description: Directory for caching reranking models
environmentVariables.name: RERANKING_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Estimated characters per token for passage size validation (default: 4.0, range: 2.0-8.0)
environmentVariables.name: RERANKING_CHARS_PER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: ONNX Runtime intra-operation parallelism threads for reranking (default: 0 = auto-detect)
environmentVariables.name: RERANKING_INTRA_OP_THREADS

environmentVariables.description: Enable ONNX Runtime CPU memory arena for reranking (default: false)
environmentVariables.name: RERANKING_CPU_MEM_ARENA

environmentVariables.description: Maximum passages per ONNX Runtime inference batch during reranking (default: 32)
environmentVariables.name: RERANKING_BATCH_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: ollama (default), openai, azure, huggingface, or voyage
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key for OpenAI embedding provider
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Custom base URL for OpenAI-compatible APIs
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI organization ID
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ORGANIZATION

environmentVariables.description: Azure OpenAI API key
environmentVariables.name: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL
environmentVariables.name: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Azure OpenAI embedding deployment name
environmentVariables.name: AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Azure OpenAI API version (default: 2024-02-01)
environmentVariables.name: AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: HuggingFace Hub API token for HuggingFace embedding provider
environmentVariables.name: HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI API key for Voyage embedding provider
environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI truncation mode: false (default) returns error when context exceeded, true enables silent truncation
environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_TRUNCATION

environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI batch size for embedding requests
environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_BATCH_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Enable LangSmith tracing
environmentVariables.name: LANGSMITH_TRACING

environmentVariables.description: LangSmith API key
environmentVariables.name: LANGSMITH_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: LangSmith project name
environmentVariables.name: LANGSMITH_PROJECT

environmentVariables.description: LangSmith API endpoint URL
environmentVariables.name: LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of metadata fields to index (field:type format)
environmentVariables.name: METADATA_INDEXED_FIELDS

environmentVariables.description: Index sync mode: strict (fail), auto (sync), warn (log), additive (default, add missing and rebuild drifted, never drop)
environmentVariables.name: METADATA_INDEX_SYNC_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Transport mode: stdio for local, http for Docker/remote
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind address (use 0.0.0.0 for Docker)
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: HTTP port number
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Enable stateless HTTP mode for horizontal scaling. Enabled by default as the server has no stateful MCP features. Set to false only if you need server-side MCP session tracking.
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_STATELESS_HTTP

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tools to disable (e.g., delete_context,update_context)
environmentVariables.name: DISABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for HTTP authentication (required when using SimpleTokenVerifier)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Client ID that identifies simple_token requests to FastMCP. Not an owner identity: simple_token requests own entries as ACCESS_CONTROL_DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Authentication provider: none (default), simple_token, jwt
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: PEM-encoded public key (asymmetric algorithms) or shared secret (HS* algorithms) for JWT verification. Mutually exclusive with MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI; exactly one is required when MCP_AUTH_PROVIDER=jwt
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY

environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint URI for JWT verification with automatic key rotation. Mutually exclusive with MCP_AUTH_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY; exactly one is required when MCP_AUTH_PROVIDER=jwt
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI

environmentVariables.description: Expected issuer (iss) claim value for JWT verification. Unset skips issuer validation
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_JWT_ISSUER

environmentVariables.description: Expected audience (aud) claim value for JWT verification. Unset skips audience validation
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: JWT signing algorithm to accept (default RS256). Supported: HS256/384/512, RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512, EdDSA, Ed25519, Ed448
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM

environmentVariables.description: PEM-encoded public key (asymmetric algorithms) or shared secret (HS* algorithms) of a second, operator-held verifier that accepts only ACCESS_CONTROL_ANONYMOUS_PRINCIPAL, composed beside the JWKS verifier. Applies only with MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI and requires ACCESS_CONTROL_ANONYMOUS_PRINCIPAL; a static-key deployment signs the anonymous token with its own MCP_AUTH_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY counterpart
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Signing algorithm the anonymous verifier accepts (default RS256; used with MCP_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY). Supported: HS256/384/512, RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512, EdDSA, Ed25519, Ed448
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_JWT_ALGORITHM

environmentVariables.description: Claim carrying the caller group memberships (default groups). Supports dotted paths and full-URL claim keys
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_GROUPS_CLAIM

environmentVariables.description: Claim carrying the caller roles (default roles). Supports dotted paths and full-URL claim keys
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_ROLES_CLAIM

environmentVariables.description: Principal id stamped as owner_id for every request without a jwt identity: stdio transport and MCP_AUTH_PROVIDER none or simple_token. Also the owner backfilled onto rows that predate the access-control columns. Default local.
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL

environmentVariables.description: Visibility stamped on stored entries when the caller does not specify one: private (owner plus every grantee), public (everyone). Default private.
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_DEFAULT_VISIBILITY

environmentVariables.description: Automatic group read grants on newly inserted entries: none (no automatic grants, default) or author_groups (every group of the writing principal receives a read grant, effective under the default private visibility).
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_DEFAULT_GROUP_GRANTS

environmentVariables.description: Role required to set visibility public. Unset (default) lets any owner publish; set to a role name to restrict publishing to callers whose verified roles claim carries that role.
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_PUBLISH_ROLE

environmentVariables.description: Principal id of the read-only jwt subject, matched verbatim against the token sub claim: every write tool refuses it, its groups and roles are discarded, and its token must carry exp. Unset (default) makes no principal read-only, and a value that differs from the minted sub leaves that token an ordinary writable principal, so the startup log names the value. environmentVariables.description: JWT signing algorithm to accept (default RS256). Supported: HS256/384/512, RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512, EdDSA, Ed25519, Ed448
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM

environmentVariables.description: PEM-encoded public key (asymmetric algorithms) or shared secret (HS* algorithms) of a second, operator-held verifier that accepts only ACCESS_CONTROL_ANONYMOUS_PRINCIPAL, composed beside the JWKS verifier. Applies only with MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI and requires ACCESS_CONTROL_ANONYMOUS_PRINCIPAL; a static-key deployment signs the anonymous token with its own MCP_AUTH_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY counterpart
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Signing algorithm the anonymous verifier accepts (default RS256; used with MCP_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY). Supported: HS256/384/512, RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512, EdDSA, Ed25519, Ed448
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_JWT_ALGORITHM

environmentVariables.description: Claim carrying the caller group memberships (default groups). Supports dotted paths and full-URL claim keys
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_GROUPS_CLAIM

environmentVariables.description: Claim carrying the caller roles (default roles). Supports dotted paths and full-URL claim keys
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_ROLES_CLAIM

environmentVariables.description: Principal id stamped as owner_id for every request without a jwt identity: stdio transport and MCP_AUTH_PROVIDER none or simple_token. Also the owner backfilled onto rows that predate the access-control columns. Default local.
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL

environmentVariables.description: Visibility stamped on stored entries when the caller does not specify one: private (owner plus every grantee), public (everyone). Default private.
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_DEFAULT_VISIBILITY

environmentVariables.description: Automatic group read grants on newly inserted entries: none (no automatic grants, default) or author_groups (every group of the writing principal receives a read grant, effective under the default private visibility).
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_DEFAULT_GROUP_GRANTS

environmentVariables.description: Role required to set visibility public. Unset (default) lets any owner publish; set to a role name to restrict publishing to callers whose verified roles claim carries that role.
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_PUBLISH_ROLE

environmentVariables.description: Principal id of the read-only jwt subject, matched verbatim against the token sub claim: every write tool refuses it, its groups and roles are discarded, and its token must carry exp. Unset (default) makes no principal read-only, and a value that differs from the minted sub leaves that token an ordinary writable principal, so the startup log names the value. Must differ from ACCESS_CONTROL_DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL.
environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_ANONYMOUS_PRINCIPAL

environmentVariables.description: Also enforce the access model in PostgreSQL through row-level security. Requires STORAGE_BACKEND=postgresql and POSTGRESQL_MIGRATION_USER naming the role that owns the tables; requests must connect as a different role that is a member of POSTGRESQL_RLS_POLICY_ROLE and neither superuser nor BYPASSRLS. Default false.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_POSTGRESQL_RLS

environmentVariables.description: NOLOGIN PostgreSQL role the row-level security policies apply to. The operator creates it and grants it to the request login role; the server grants it the table privileges. 1-63 characters from a-z 0-9 _, not starting with a digit. Default mcp_context_request.
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRESQL_RLS_POLICY_ROLE

environmentVariables.description: Custom server instructions text. Overrides built-in default. Set to empty string to disable.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS

environmentVariables.description: Enable TurboQuant embedding compression at storage time. Default true. When true (default), fp32 embeddings are replaced with bit-packed compressed payloads (~8x storage reduction at default bits=4). Set to false to opt out and keep fp32 storage.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_EMBEDDING_COMPRESSION

environmentVariables.description: Compression provider. Currently only 'turboquant' is supported.
environmentVariables.name: COMPRESSION_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Bits per coordinate for compression: 2 (16x), 3 (~11x), 4 (8x). Default 4. Lower bound 2 required by the inner-product variant.
environmentVariables.name: COMPRESSION_BITS

environmentVariables.description: Compression variant. 'ip' (default) uses Algorithm 2 with QJL for unbiased inner-product estimation. 'mse' uses Algorithm 1 (L2-optimal reconstruction).
environmentVariables.name: COMPRESSION_VARIANT

environmentVariables.description: Rotation matrix seed. Default 0. Pick any stable integer in [0, 4294967295] (the seed is packed into the compressed payload as an unsigned 32-bit field); the value is persisted in compression_metadata at first startup and treated as load-bearing thereafter (mismatching env vs DB raises ConfigurationError(78)).
environmentVariables.name: COMPRESSION_SEED

environmentVariables.description: Max concurrent compression encode workers dispatched to threads (the CPU-bound codec section is serialized by a process-wide BLAS-limits lock, so this bounds worker fan-out, not CPU parallelism). Separate from I/O-bound EMBEDDING_MAX_CONCURRENT and SUMMARY_MAX_CONCURRENT. Default min(cpu_count, 4).
environmentVariables.name: COMPRESSION_MAX_CONCURRENT
